title: Joint Identification of Linear Dynamics and Noise Covariance via Distributional Estimation
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel framework for the joint identification of system dynamics and noise covariance in linear systems, under general noise distributions beyond Gaussian. Specifically, we would like to simultaneously estimate the dynamical matrix $A$ and the noise covariance matrix $\varSigma$ using state transition data. The formulation builds upon a novel parameterization of the state-transition distribution, which enables more effective use of distributional "shape" information for improved identification accuracy.
